control.description-key: Configuration-driven record header card plus toolbar for any Dataverse entity. Entity and record are self-detected from the form context. Field layout comes from the layoutJson property, or is derived from entity metadata when that property is blank.

property.name: boundField
property.description-key: Any SingleLine.Text field on the host entity. PCF replaces this fields rendering with the record header card. Bind to the entitys primary name column for standard placement.

property.name: title
property.description-key: Title text shown inline with the toolbar icons. Defaults to the layoutJson title, then to the entity display name, when left blank.

property.name: showVersion
property.description-key: When enabled, renders the vX.Y.Z build stamp at the bottom of the header. Disable for a cleaner production look.

property.name: layoutJson
property.description-key: RecordHeaderConfiguration v1.0 JSON describing title, columns, summaryField and the ordered field list. Leave blank to derive a default layout from entity metadata. A malformed value falls back to those defaults and logs a warning.
